title: MED+250 authoritative pharmacy GPS readiness review ledger
summary: Redacted aggregate ledger for record-level pharmacy premises review. Ninety-three active pharmacy records currently have governed GPS evidence; the remaining active records require an approved coordinate decision or an explicit production-scope decision.

checks.name: Authoritative registry population
checks.detail: The review population is bound to the 769-row current Rwanda FDA retail-pharmacy release file and the matching aggregate production health snapshot.

checks.name: Approved GPS evidence
checks.detail: Ninety-three pharmacy records have exact current-registry name and locality matches to a Government of Rwanda geospatial source with the governed accuracy rule.

checks.name: No fabricated proximity
checks.detail: Records without approved coordinates are not assigned invented coordinates or a fabricated distance; the application uses the national-service label for unverified proximity.

checks.name: Full active-registry review
checks.detail: Six hundred seventy-six active pharmacy records do not yet have approved GPS evidence. The operations owner must approve authoritative premises evidence or explicitly remove each unresolved record from the intended GPS-ready production scope.

checks.name: Record-level owner decisions
checks.detail: A controlled private ledger must record one decision per active pharmacy with reviewer identity, source version, evidence outcome and timezone-qualified review timestamp.

completion_instructions: Keep the row-level ledger in the controlled operations location because it contains precise pharmacy locations.
Decide every active pharmacy record and make the intended GPS-ready production scope match actual routing and customer presentation.
Do not approve a Google Maps link, generated search URL or name-only candidate as authoritative premises GPS.
Regenerate the aggregate production health snapshot after applying every approved or excluded decision.
Set pending_records and blocked_records to zero, add the named reviewer, role and timestamp, set every check to passed, and set status to complete.
Validate this redacted artifact strictly and add it to data/launch-evidence.json with its exact SHA-256 digest.
